workload.note: 340/512 passing, 3,727 pass yds, 26 pass TD, 13 INT, plus 498 rush yds and 2 rush TD (per Pro-Football-Reference).

contract.note: Signed multi-year extension with Chargers on 2023-07-25 (per Chargers.com); publicly reported historically as 5-year, $262.5M. No 2026 restructure/new extension found.

scheme.note: Chargers hired Mike McDaniel (former Dolphins HC) as offensive coordinator for 2026, working under HC Jim Harbaugh. McDaniel is implementing a new scheme emphasizing anticipatory throws, expedited decision-making, and improved shotgun footwork.

notes: Herbert has played his entire career (2020-2026) with the Chargers; no team change.
Herbert trained in the offseason with his brother Patrick Herbert (Jaguars TE) to refine mechanics ahead of the 2026 McDaniel scheme install.

LT Rashawn Slater (2x Pro Bowler) is returning from a torn patellar tendon suffered 2025-08-03 that cost him the entire 2025 season; his camp reps are being monitored as an OL-health factor around Herbert.
Named pass-catchers seen working with Herbert in camp (2026-07-30 Chargers.com report): Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris, Keaton Mitchell, Brenen Thompson.

injury.status: Healthy / no injury reported in camp
